name: aegistranslate
description: Private, on-device multimodal translation for Firefox

scripts.test: node --test test/*.test.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s test/helper
scripts.lint: npm run build && web-ext lint -s dist
scripts.start: npm run build && web-ext run -s dist
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build -s dist -a web-ext-artifacts --overwrite-dest
